name: Cabinet
description: A lightweight self-hosted file cabinet and document manager.
summary: Cabinet v0.5.0 (2026-07-04) is a major release with 238 commits introducing Connect Knowledge (Google Drive, iCloud, OneDrive, Dropbox integration), a 52-connector Integrations Hub (Slack, Google, Microsoft 365, Snowflake, LinkedIn, Discord, Telegram), per-room agent Channels, a Telegram remote-control gateway, and a 'Manila Arc' borderless UI redesign. Security improvements include PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt and login rate-limiting. v0.6.0 introduces a self-update mechanism, with future releases published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases. Clean-path routing replaces hash-based routing as a notable breaking change.

answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — v0.5.0 released 2026-07-04 and v0.6.0 followed with a self-updater
answers.Does it support user authentication?: Yes — PBKDF2 password hashing with per-install salt, login rate-limiting, and KB_PASSWORD gate

breaking_excerpts: Clean-path routing: the app serves clean URLs instead of hash routes across web and Electron; old hash links are parsed via a marker-scan fallback but canonical form is now path-based.
Channels on-disk rename: the internal team-chat directory moved from '.slack' to '.channels', scoped per room.
v0.6.0 moves the update channel; future releases are published at https://github.com/cabinetai/cabinet-releases instead of the original repository.

alternatives.name: Paperless-ngx
alternatives.review: Paperless-ngx offers far more powerful OCR, tagging, and document indexing than Cabinet, but is significantly heavier to deploy and maintain.

alternatives.name: Teedy
alternatives.review: Teedy provides a more enterprise-grade document management experience with workflows and permissions, but requires more resources than Cabinet.

alternatives.name: Nextcloud
alternatives.review: Nextcloud is a full-featured cloud platform with file management and document editing, but is far more complex than Cabinet's focused file cabinet approach.

alternatives.name: Docspell
alternatives.review: Docspell excels at automated document organization and OCR processing, but has a steeper setup curve compared to Cabinet's simplicity.

alternatives.name: Filestash
alternatives.review: Filestash is similarly lightweight and supports multiple storage backends, but focuses more on file browsing than document management workflows.
